name: Mina Silva
source:
A dancer with light movements and a pretty face, she has made a living by preforming sensual dances. She fell in love with Anduke's strength and clings to him as they travel together.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char09.html]Mink[/url]]
